X1.head: e129e76e25deff7314efe3b72996d295cf73f7f3
X1.text:
"""Schema9 adds separate public/private member records without rewriting historical facts."""

PROFILE_TABLES = {"member_presentations", "member_preferences"}
PROFILE_STATEMENTS = (
    "CREATE TABLE member_presentations(member_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "
    "household_id TEXT NOT NULL, alias TEXT, "
    "revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision>=1), "
    "FOREIGN KEY(household_id,member_id) REFERENCES members(household_id,member_id), "
    "CHECK(alias IS NULL OR (typeof(alias)='text' AND length(alias) BETWEEN 1 AND 80)))",
    "CREATE TABLE member_preferences(member_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "
    "household_id TEXT NOT NULL, locale TEXT CHECK(locale IS NULL OR locale IN ('en','es')), "
    "routine_participation_summaries INTEGER NOT NULL "
    "CHECK(typeof(routine_participation_summaries)='integer' "
    "AND routine_participation_summaries IN (0,1)), "
    "revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision>=1), "
    "FOREIGN KEY(household_id,member_id) REFERENCES members(household_id,member_id))",
    "INSERT INTO member_presentations(member_id,household_id,alias,revision) "
    "SELECT member_id,household_id,NULL,1 FROM members",
    "INSERT INTO member_preferences(member_id,household_id,locale,"
    "routine_participation_summaries,revision) SELECT member_id,household_id,NULL,1,1 FROM members",
)

X1.text:
IDENTITY_STATEMENTS = (
    "CREATE TABLE members(member_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "
    "household_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES households(household_id), ha_user_id TEXT NOT NULL, "
    "role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('administrator','adult','restricted','viewer')), "
    "status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','active','suspended','archived')), "
    "revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>=1), exceptions TEXT NOT NULL, "
    "UNIQUE(household_id,ha_user_id))",
    "CREATE TABLE household_policy(household_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY "
    "REFERENCES households(household_id), mapping_mode TEXT NOT NULL, target_ha_user_id TEXT, "
    "revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>=1), adjustments TEXT NOT NULL, "
    "CHECK((mapping_mode='all_ha_administrators' AND target_ha_user_id IS NULL) "
    "OR (mapping_mode IN ('setup_administrator','selected_ha_user') "
    "AND target_ha_user_id IS NOT NULL)))",
)
RECOVERY_STATEMENTS = (
    "CREATE TABLE recovery_requests(request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "
    "household_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES households(household_id), "
    "target_ha_user_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>=1), "
    "state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','approved','consumed','canceled')), "
    "created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, detail TEXT NOT NULL)",
    "CREATE INDEX recovery_pending ON recovery_requests(household_id,state,expires_at)",
)
SCHEMA_STATEMENTS = (
    *BASE_STATEMENTS,
    *IDENTITY_STATEMENTS,
    *RECOVERY_STATEMENTS,
    *HISTORY_STATEMENTS,
    *TASK_STATEMENTS,
    *MATERIAL_STATEMENTS,
    *REVIEW_STATEMENTS,
    *RECURRENCE_STATEMENTS,
    *PROFILE_STATEMENTS,
